title: Derived SEO ninth-row archive guard rejects source and prevents new Brain/Heartbeat ACK
root_cause: Original migration 20261112214500 added the ninth source seo_opportunity_intelligence to existing powerhouse_daily_source_archive_v1(date), but the existing terminal source insert-count guard v_saved<>8 was not updated. The function now constructs nine rows and correctly raises GROWTH_SOURCE_MANIFEST_INCOMPLETE:9, leaving 12-Nov 20-row daily manifest without derived SEO row and preventing a new Brain/Heartbeat sourceRevision ACK.
impact: Previously persisted original SEO observation is not represented in same-day daily source manifest; old 20-source consumer ACK may be stale although runtime architecture reports wired.
fix: New guarded native GitOps migration changes only the original archive function's terminal count from 8 to 9, asserts exact prior derived owner/status markers and immutable function identity. Retains original canonical #175/#140/Heartbeat lanes, source manifests, tenant security and scheduled jobs.
prevention_rule: Every change to the original source UNION inventory must atomically update the exact inserted-source count and pass a no-extra-source historical/shadow/canary regression in protected CI and actual native preview before main; producer success is never a consumer ACK.
owner: Original Powerhouse source archive #175 → original ONE BRAIN #140 / commercial Heartbeat; one existing scheduler
outcome: CANDIDATE_NOT_LIVE; requires native preview and protected merge, independent function-text native readback, original #175 same-day source receipt, new #140 exact SHA consumer ACK, Heartbeat exact SHA and later CRO outcome.
